quotations: DAC, The Chips to Systems Conference, has opened its 2027 Call for Contributions, inviting researchers and industry practitioners to explore the technologies changing electronic design. Scheduled for July 11–14, 2027, at the San Jose Convention Center, the event will be DAC’s first gathering in San Jose.

Contributions will span AI, Design, electronic design automation, Security and Systems. Participants can submit research papers, engineering presentations, panel proposals, special sessions, workshops and tutorials, alongside opportunities in the DAC Pavilion and Exhibitor Forum.
